post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not re-run single-family or regrouped ablations of the same default-on sizing/cap/add-on stack on the same three frozen windows, do not sweep neutralization values (partial multipliers between accepted and 1.0), and do not promote the commodities/gold cap removal from the single-window +2.73% signal alone. The per-family marginal-contribution table is now measured and machine-readable in the artifact; repeating it adds no evidence.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: A follow-up confirmation ticket may test ONLY the predeclared complexity-reduction bundle (clean_spy_leader family caps, and optionally commodities/gold caps) with its own fresh Gate 4 on an unseen or extended window set, or with materially new settled forward rows; any boost-family removal retry needs a genuinely new allocator mechanism or out-of-sample window, not a re-read of this table. Defensive haircut removal is falsified at -63% EV and is a frozen direction.
post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: Under the enforced cash ledger the boost families still add EV (risk-on leader -6.86% when removed, rs top-ups -6.61%, mid-sector dispersion -5.18%, financials -2.61%, 200MA extension -2.02%, add-on stack -1.49% EV / -$7.2k PnL), so the champion is not carrying leverage-era dead weight in its boosts; the defensive haircut stack is the single most load-bearing family (63% of aggregate EV, removing it adds 17 bad trades and doubles worst drawdown to 18%). Near-zero families: clean_spy_leader caps (+0.61% EV when removed; caps above 0.40 rarely bind once cash admission scales fills) and signal_day_green (-0.51%). Commodities/gold caps show +2.73% EV from a single late_strong window only (mid/old byte-identical) - classic single-window noise, below the 10% bar. All 33 ablated window runs had zero negative-cash events; the ledger held everywhere.
